headline.text: The Spanish cobicistat label reports higher plasma concentrations of darunavir when given with cobicistat.

reported.text: The Spanish cobicistat label reports increased plasma concentrations of CYP3A-metabolised medicines, darunavir included, with cobicistat.
The French darunavir label says darunavir given with cobicistat decreases creatinine clearance.

mechanism.text: The Spanish label attributes the rise in darunavir concentrations to cobicistat and CYP3A metabolism of darunavir.

claims.text: The Spanish cobicistat label says plasma concentrations of CYP3A-metabolised medicines, including darunavir, increase when given together with cobicistat.
claims.quote: Se observa un aumento de las concentraciones plasmáticas de los medicamentos metabolizados por el CYP3A (incluyendo atazanavir y darunavir) cuando se administran de forma concomitante con cobicistat.
claims.quoteEnglish: An increase in plasma concentrations is seen for medicines metabolised by CYP3A (including atazanavir and darunavir) when they are administered concomitantly with cobicistat.
claims.judgeRationale: The Spanish quote names darunavir among CYP3A substrates with increased concentrations, and the English rendering is faithful.

claims.text: The French darunavir label says darunavir given with cobicistat lowers creatinine clearance.
claims.quote: Le darunavir co-administré avec le cobicistat diminue la clairance de la créatinine.
claims.quoteEnglish: Darunavir co-administered with cobicistat decreases creatinine clearance.
claims.judgeRationale: The French quote says darunavir with cobicistat decreases creatinine clearance, and the English rendering is faithful.

pharmacistQuestions.text: The label describes this interaction, but there seem to be no human studies of it. How is it usually handled for someone like me?
Do any of my other medicines contain Cobicistat or Darunavir, or work the same way?
Does my dose, or the time between taking Cobicistat and Darunavir, change how much this matters?

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
